name: parameterized-review
description: Parameterization demo: ONE map body dispatches to a DIFFERENT specialist agent per item via `agents/${item}.md`, instead of N near-identical copies. Swap the panel (the `over` list) or wire it from an input to review anything through any set of expert lenses. The same `${...}` interpolation now resolves in agent / agents[] / subflow / route.router / loop.judge paths — so a generic flow can pick its agents (or sub-orchestrations) at runtime.

phases.name: panel-review
phases.description: Fan out to a panel of specialists chosen BY NAME at runtime — one body, many agents. `agents/${item}.md` resolves to a different agent for each item in `over`.

body.name: review
body.prompt:
Review the following from your discipline's lens. Be specific and concrete.

${input}

phases.name: synthesize
phases.description: Pull the panel's reviews together into one assessment.
phases.prompt:
Synthesize these expert reviews into one balanced assessment — the key agreements and the tensions.

${reviews}
